correctness.rationale: The proof in RESULT.md explicitly defines cyclic Fourier normalization and ordered convolution; expands the union into T+2 tau_s T+tau_2s T, deriving E=4a^3+2a+8C(s)+2C(2s) without asymptotics. Nonnegative overlap shows the universal packing lower bound, while disjoint packet support gives the exact threshold and every extremizing shift. A nested-centered-interval argument establishes strict C monotonicity. In the window n=3(2a-1)-t with 0<=t<=a, both overlap tails are at most a, yielding the exact integer cubic F_t. Its rigorously increasing first difference gives the quadratic root, ceiling rule and all integer Pell ties; the cubic asymptotic follows from B(v)=v^3/6+O(v^2). No unproved nonstandard lemma is used. Direct ordered-pair convolution checks passed for 504 independent (n,a) instances, plus 500 exact tie tests and large Pell witnesses; they do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: Two separated rectangular windows are a canonical binary cyclic Fourier aperture, and the fourth Fourier moment measures its collision concentration/spectral flatness. The exact packing threshold is a sharp geometric design cutoff, while the entire first a-step deficiency window admits a complete optimizer and energy law. Unexpected sparse Pell-degeneracy levels show a genuine arithmetic mechanism controlling multiple optimum layouts, and the cubic defect coefficient gives a quantitative boundary scale. These are structured exact-invariant results, not mere isolated small-case enumeration; the remaining smaller-modulus regime is explicitly out of scope.
